description: This header file declares functions and structures related to managing a pager interface within the git version control system, including setup, checking if in use, and configuring appearance elements like color and size.

methods.name: git_pager
methods.description: Retrieves the pager command for a given repository, considering output terminal status.

methods.name: setup_pager
methods.description: Sets up the pager environment for a given repository.

methods.name: wait_for_pager
methods.description: Waits for the pager process to complete.

methods.name: pager_in_use
methods.description: Checks if the pager is currently in use.

methods.name: term_columns
methods.description: Gets the number of columns of the terminal.

methods.name: term_clear_line
methods.description: Clears the current line in the terminal.

methods.name: decimal_width
methods.description: Returns the number of digits needed to display a given unsigned integer.

methods.name: check_pager_config
methods.description: Checks the configuration for the pager command.

methods.name: prepare_pager_args
methods.description: Prepares arguments for launching the pager process.
